map.标准地法每公顷蓄积: Stock per hectare by the sample plot method
map.标准地法：每公顷蓄积=样地蓄积÷样地面积×10000；角规法按断面积系数推算每公: Sample plot method: stock per hectare = sample plot stock ÷ sample plot area × 10000. The angle-gauge method derives the basal area per hectare and multiplies it by the form height to get the stock. The mean experimental form factor method uses v = g × tree height × f, summed to give the stock per unit area.
map.标准地 600 m²、实测蓄积 9 m³：每公顷蓄积=9/600×10000=1: A 600 m² sample plot with 9 m³ measured: stock per hectare = 9/600×10000 = 150 m³/ha; if the angle gauge gives 28 m² of basal area per hectare and a form height of 5.4, the stock is ≈28×5.4=151 m³/ha, and the two methods agree.
map.角规和标准地哪种更准？: Which is more accurate, the angle gauge or the sample plot?
map.标准地直接实测更准但费工，角规快速但受林分均匀度影响；大面积普查常用角规，重点地: The sample plot is measured directly so it is more accurate but labour-intensive, while the angle gauge is fast but affected by stand uniformity; large-area inventories usually use the angle gauge and key plots use the sample plot for verification.
map.形高怎么取？: How do I take the form height?
map.形高=蓄积÷断面积，随树种、地位级变化，查当地形高表或二元表；用错形高会系统性偏: Form height = stock ÷ basal area. It varies by species and site class, so look it up in the local form height table or a two-entry table; using the wrong form height introduces systematic bias.
